Hi Vivek,

I grabbed the Redwood benchmarking report this morning (thanks for making it public) — some impressive latency numbers. I'm on the infra team at DataForge and we're evaluating options to reduce token cost spikes for our user-facing pipeline.

Would you be open to a 30-minute technical deep-dive where we can walk through our sample traces and see if Redwood's batching/cache strategies would help? Ideally we'd include one of our SREs and a product manager.

Rough availability next week: Tue-Thu mornings (PDT) or Friday afternoon. Happy to send sample traces in advance.

- Tue 9/16 09:00–11:30 PDT
